summary.result: And the results for 90 years (divided into 2011~2040, 2041~2070, 2071~2100) were that the future annual precipitation were increased 8.8 %, 9.6 %, 11.3 % respectively.
summary.background: The objective of this study was to correct the bias of the Representative Concentration Pathways (RCP)-based future precipitation data using a quantile mapping method.
summary.method: As the results of bias correction over the past 30 years (1976~2005), the annual precipitation was increased 16.3 % overall.
